title: Finance
subtitle: Accounts receivable, aging, and statements
forbidden: You do not have permission to view financial reports.

clients.title: Customer lookup
clients.hint: Enter a customer ID to see movements and balance.

overdue.title: Overdue invoices — reminders
overdue.hint: Send a payment reminder (email channel by default). One send per invoice per day.
overdue.empty: No overdue invoices match the filter.

payables.title: Payable invoices — suppliers
payables.hint: Active vouchers with pending balance and due-date alert state (#275).
payables.empty: No pending vouchers match the filter.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.hint: Issued credit notes linked to voided invoices in the selected period (module billing.credit_notes). Optional customer ID filters by originating invoice customer.
creditNotes.empty: No credit notes in this range.

libroIva.title: Accounting — VAT sales book
libroIva.hint: Export Libro IVA Ventas (ARCA RG 3685) from persisted invoice fiscal fields. Module finance.ledger required.
libroIva.empty: No preview data for this period.
libroIva.arcaPending: ARCA official validator confirmation may be pending; use preview totals before filing.

libroIvaCompras.title: Accounting — VAT purchases book
libroIvaCompras.hint: Register supplier vouchers with the form below, review the period preview, then export ARCA or Excel. Module finance.ledger required (ADR-0014).
libroIvaCompras.empty: No preview data for this period.
libroIvaCompras.arcaPending: ARCA official validator confirmation may be pending; use preview totals before filing.

comprobanteCompra.vencimientoHint: When omitted, derived from the supplier payment terms.

errors.numeroInvalid: Number must be a positive integer.

documentoCompra.title: Import purchase document
documentoCompra.hint: Upload a PDF or image (jpg, png, webp, heic). When an ARCA QR is present, main fields are prefilled locally. Review before confirming.
documentoCompra.batchHint: You can upload up to 20 files at once. If tiers 1–3 fail and local Ollama is configured (OLLAMA_URL), Tier 4 extraction is attempted.
documentoCompra.dropHint: Drag a file here or use the button to select one.
documentoCompra.dropHintBatch: Drag one or more files (max 20) or use the button to select them.
documentoCompra.tier1Hint: ARCA QR decoded locally (no portal verification)
documentoCompra.tier3Hint: local OCR (Tesseract) + template — review yellow fields
documentoCompra.batchUploaded: {{count}} documents uploaded — review each one before confirming.
documentoCompra.proveedorNotMatched: No supplier matches the issuer CUIT. Select or create the supplier before confirming.
documentoCompra.duplicateWarning: An active purchase voucher already exists for this supplier with the same type, prefix and number (voucher #{{comprobanteId}}). Fix the data or void the existing voucher before confirming.
documentoCompra.itemsEmpty: No line items were detected. You can still confirm the voucher header only.

inlineArticulo.title: New product
inlineArticulo.descripcionRequired: Description must be at least 3 characters.

templates.title: Extraction templates (YAML)
templates.hint: Bundled templates (AR/BR/UY) apply automatically. You can add tenant custom templates without redeploy.
templates.yamlPlaceholder:
issuer: my-supplier
keywords:
  - INVOICE
fields:
  vat_id:
    regex: "..."
templates.contentTooShort: YAML must be at least 20 characters.

errors.totalRequired: Total must be greater than zero.
